info.syllabusName: Cú pháp học tiếng Anh_English Syntax
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 104 hours self-study
info.description:
Course description:

This course offers an introduction to the practical analysis of English sentence structure and is designed for English learners who are into the field of linguistics.The course provides key concepts in English sentence structure such as constituency, category and functions, employing tree diagrams and practices of drawing tree diagrams which help learners make sense of the knowledge provided. The exercises are relevant, not only for reviewing syntactic aspects and discussions of in-text exercises but also for constructing interrelationships between syntactic knowledge in different languages and ones of related areas in linguistics. References for further reading are given at the end of each chapter to offer learners choices for extensive reading about related subjects.

Course objective:

The course aims to provide students knowledge of syntax for applying to their studying linguistics and for generating accurate content in English for different communication purposes.

Teaching and Learning Methodology:

This course applies instructional, communicative, and interactive discussions. It is appropriate for different teaching and learning tendencies involving instructors' instructions on pre-lesson and post lesson exercises meant to apply learnt skills; ancillary lectures and seminars to enhance active interest in the topics; or interactive discussions leading by students followed by instructors' feedback and conclusions. Open-mindedness and questions from both students and instructors are encouraged if misunderstandings related to the subject knowledge arise.

clos.loDetails: Differentiate between types, levels, categories and functions of constituents in structures of simple sentences
Deconstruct structures of clauses and complex sentences by identifying appropriate functions of constituents
Transform phrases, clauses, and sentences into syntactic tree diagrams by using phrase markers or triangles
Generate accurate phrases, clauses, and sentences by applying syntactic rules of combining appropriate constituents
Compare and contrast the syntactic knowledge in English language with other languages
Apply syntactic knowledge in generating English content in related majored subjects and in communication
Construct extensive knowledge of syntax with related areas in linguistics by evaluating various resources
Collaborate effectively with other members in class activities, discussions, and group work

Presentation on a topic:
Option 1: Suggested topics: 1. Verb Phrases; 2. Adverbials; 3. Auxilliary Verb Phrases; 4. Noun phrases; 5. Sentences within sentences; 6. Wh-clauses; 7. Non-finite Clauses

Option 2: Follow lecturer's proposal
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Lessons learned in the course; evaluating, comparing and contrasting, synthesizing content from various resources
assessments.gradingGuide:
- Students are divided into small groups of 4-5 members to give a group oral presentation (within 25 - 30 minutes) on a topic given by instructors.
- The presentation content must include sufficient content on the topic learned in the course with practical examples, common syntactic errors identified among language learners, and similarities and differences between English and Vietnamese regarding the syntactic aspects observed.
- The presentation has two main parts for assessing:
(1) group score 50%: organization, subject knowledge, slides;
(2) individual score 50%: language use, presentation skills
For more details, please refer to the Appendix.
assessments.note: Instructions, schedules, and topics for each assignment must be provided to students in advance.
